description: Recent reports highlight Shuhei Yoshida's views on the indie game industry and specific game labels according to Indonesian sources.

sections.heading: Search Trend Overview
paragraphs: The search term "shuhei yoshida" has shown significant activity in the ID region. Google Trends reported a search lower bound of 200 for this term. The trend feed capturing this data was published on August 18, 2026.

sections.heading: Indie Game Industry Growth
paragraphs: According to Mistar.id, Shuhei Yoshida commented on the current state of the indie game sector. The source reports that he stated the indie game industry is becoming larger. Furthermore, the report notes that Yoshida observed competition within the industry is also getting tighter.

sections.heading: Impact of AI on Gaming
paragraphs: In addition to general industry growth, the role of technology is being discussed. Achmad Nur Hidayat reported that artificial intelligence and the indie industry are working to tighten competition in the game market.

sections.heading: Advice on Game Labeling
paragraphs: Specific advice regarding a particular title was also highlighted in the news. According to pdiperjuanganbali.id, Shuhei Yoshida suggested that the game "Clair Obscur" should avoid using the label of a turn-based RPG.

faq.q: What did Shuhei Yoshida say about the indie game industry?
faq.a: According to Mistar.id, Shuhei Yoshida stated that the indie game industry is getting bigger and that competition is also becoming tighter.

faq.q: What suggestion was made regarding Clair Obscur?
faq.a: According to pdiperjuanganbali.id, Shuhei Yoshida suggested that Clair Obscur should avoid the label of a turn-based RPG.

faq.q: How is artificial intelligence affecting the industry according to reports?
faq.a: Achmad Nur Hidayat reported that artificial intelligence and the indie industry are tightening competition in the game sector.
